answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The quartz edge is entered both ways, so a closed ring of 14 clones produces a signature the falcon analysis flags immediately. Anyone must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the violet settlement applies the void retroactively. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
